#Function for dotplot
```{r}
plot_sc_dotplot <- function(sc_object, gene_vector, celltype_col = "celltype", 
                            save_path = NULL, width = 8, height = 5) {
  
  # 1. Extract cell types
  if (!celltype_col %in% colnames(colData(sc_object))) {
    stop(paste("Column", celltype_col, "not found in colData(sc_object)"))
  }
  celltypes <- colData(sc_object)[[celltype_col]]
  
  # 2. Filter for valid genes
  genes_to_use <- gene_vector[gene_vector %in% rownames(sc_object)]
  if(length(genes_to_use) == 0) {
    stop("None of the provided genes were found in the sc_object.")
  }
  
  # 3. Extract sparse matrix ONLY for genes of interest
  # Using "logcounts" - ensure your sc_object has this assay!
  expr_mat <- assay(sc_object, "logcounts")[genes_to_use, , drop = FALSE]
  
  # 4. Compute average expression per cell type (using Matrix::rowMeans for safety)
  std_prof <- sapply(unique(celltypes), function(ct) {
    Matrix::rowMeans(expr_mat[, celltypes == ct, drop = FALSE])
  })
  
  # 5. Compute % expressing cells (using Matrix::rowMeans on a sparse logical matrix)
  pct_expr <- sapply(unique(celltypes), function(ct) {
    subset_mat <- expr_mat[, celltypes == ct, drop = FALSE]
    Matrix::rowMeans(subset_mat > 0)
  })
  
  # 6. Convert to data.frame
  std_prof <- as.data.frame(std_prof)
  std_prof$gene <- rownames(std_prof)
  
  std_prof_pct <- as.data.frame(pct_expr)
  std_prof_pct$gene <- rownames(std_prof_pct)
  
  # 7. Reshape to Long format
  expr_long <- std_prof %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -gene, names_to = "celltype", values_to = "expression")
  
  pct_long <- std_prof_pct %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -gene, names_to = "celltype", values_to = "percent")
  
  # 8. Merge expression + percent and filter
  expr_long <- expr_long %>%
    left_join(pct_long, by = c("gene", "celltype")) %>%
    filter(expression > 0)
  
  # 9. Generate the plot
  p <- ggplot(expr_long, aes(x = gene, y = celltype)) +
    geom_point(aes(size = percent, color = expression)) +
    scale_color_gradient(low = "grey90", high = "red", name = "Mean\nExpression") +
    scale_size(range = c(1, 6), name = "% Expressing", labels = scales::percent_format()) + 
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    labs(x = "Gene", y = "Cell Type")
  
  # 10. Save if path is provided
  if (!is.null(save_path)) {
    ggsave(filename = save_path, plot = p, width = width, height = height, bg = "white")
    message("Plot saved to: ", save_path)
  }
  
  return(p)
}
```

#Applying the function
```{r}
my_plot <- plot_sc_dotplot(combined_sham, genes_axone_guidance, celltype_col = "new_cell_type",
                           save_path = "sham_dotplot.png")
my_plot <- plot_sc_dotplot(combined_c26, genes_axone_guidance, celltype_col = "new_cell_type",
                           save_path = "c26_dotplot.png")
```
